تعرقبتا (form IIq)
# تَعَرْقَبَتَا (taʕarqabatā) /ta.ʕar.qa.ba.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of تَعَرْقَبَ (taʕarqaba)
# تُعُرْقِبَتَا (tuʕurqibatā) /tu.ʕur.qi.ba.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of تَعَرْقَبَ (taʕarqaba)
